distribution.narrative: Lai et al. (2020) reported six specimens from Xishuangbanna, Yunnan: five recovered from dissected rubber-tree logs and one captured in an ethanol-baited trap. The published record supports a Yunnan occurrence, but the checklist assessment remains under review.
distribution.evidence: Xishuangbanna, Yunnan; five specimens from logs and one ethanol-trap specimen (Lai et al., 2020, Table 1, p. 628).

original_type_locality.note: Original type material; this is outside the China checklist.

hosts.association: Type series recorded ex Afzelia xylocarpa; original 1972 source.
Five adults recovered from dissected rubber-tree logs; this does not establish attack on healthy standing trees.

host_note: Host and wood-substrate evidence are shown with their original country and method. The ethanol-trapped specimen is not assigned a host plant; the five rubber-log specimens do not establish colonization of healthy living rubber trees.
taxonomy_summary: Platypus afzeliae Browne, 1972 retains the original generic combination. The 1972 protologue has been directly examined; the 2020 Chinese report uses the same scientific name.

taxonomic_history.event: Subsequent published usage (not a nomenclatural act)
taxonomic_history.name: Platypus afzeliae
taxonomic_history.note: The taxon was reported from rubber-tree sampling in Xishuangbanna, Yunnan. This is a distribution and substrate record, not a new combination or synonymy.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus afzeliae
taxonomic_history.note: Described as a new species on pp. 29–30; the type series was collected in Thailand, Donglam, ex Afzelia xylocarpa.

nomenclature_note: No distinct published synonym or replacement name has been verified for this species in the reviewed evidence. The original and current combinations are identical.

resources.specimens: Original Thai type series (Browne, 1972); six Chinese specimens reported by Lai et al. (2020).
resources.images: No independently verified publicly reusable image specified in the reviewed evidence.
resources.molecular: No accession documented in the two cited sources reviewed for this pilot.
resources.symbionts: No symbiont evidence included in this pilot.
